barriers: Upstream proprietary and subscription sources: Clarivate Web of Science records ('Archaeology' category, n = 28,871, filtered to 9,697 articles in 20 journals) and Clarivate Journal Citation Indicator h-indices used to select the journals. The reproducibility-review data (47 reviews of 25 JAS manuscripts, Fig. 5) come from confidential peer review of submitted manuscripts, so the raw review records are not public. The paper says all figures can be reproduced with the code and data in the compendium, so the derived summary data are taken as deposited (Tier 0).
